hannah (procurement): Heads-up: Vendor Kite updated PO `PO-79921` — 11 H200s moved to 'RMA-quarantine' after a cooling-sensor lot flag. ETA bumped 14d -> 40d.
diego (supply-ops): Oof. Reserved for EU edge pool, right? How many are clean vs quarantined?
hannah (procurement): All 11 are in the same lot; vendor says 5 can be validated quickly, 6 need sensor swaps.
sora (eng-sre): Losing 11 = ~16% increase in nightly batch tail latency. We can partially mitigate by throttling some pipelines but customer impact risk rises. Need cost tradeoffs.
liam (logistics): Operational note: split shipments + crossdock swaps require repair affidavits and may change HS code. Customs could hit duties if classified as 'import of new goods'. That risk ~€200-700/unit.
natalia (vendor_kite): Confirmed. Options: A) release 5 pre-validated units in 10 days (expedite fee $320/unit + +10% freight), B) do crossdock sensor-swap for 6 units (we provide repair affidavit), or C) loaners (refurb) while we fix, at $95/day/unit. We can offer 7% credit on delayed 6 if you accept full delay.
diego (supply-ops): Quick math? What is loaner total vs expedite + freight?
hannah (procurement): Rough: expedite ~ $320 + $95 freight share =~$415/unit. Loaner for 30d = $2,850/unit (way higher). Credit 7% on list price (~$630/unit) if delayed -> seems cheaper than loaner.
sora (eng-sre): Infra impact estimate: ~€28k over 6w. Spread 11 units ~€2.5k/unit. So paying expedite for 5 is worth it; rest take credit.
liam (logistics): If crossdock route chosen, require serial manifest + supplier affidavit before booking bay. Also need to reserve certified tech for sensor swaps (2-3d hold per unit).
natalia (vendor_kite): We can provide serials + bench logs EOD and draft the repair affidavit. Also, if you sign a short addendum committing to next quarter top-off, we can bump the credit to 9% and waive expedite fee on the first 3 units.
diego (supply-ops): That helps. Proposal: accept Natalie's improved offer: expedite 5 units (waive fee on first 3), take 6 delayed with 9% credit, vendor to provide serials now. Legal to draft addendum.
hannah (procurement): Agreed. Liam, once serials are in can you prep DAP booking and crossdock plan? ops-bot create ticket.
liam (logistics): Will do. Need refurbishment declaration only if loaners used.
ops-bot: Ticket INF-9244 created: "Vendor Kite H200 quarantine: partial expedite + delayed tranche (PO-79921)". Assignees: liam, diego, hannah. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-9244
sora (eng-sre): One more: if you send preflight firmware diffs include thermal calibration vectors. We'll gate pre-validated units behind a 48h ramp and telemetry check.
natalia (vendor_kite): Understood — serials, bench logs, firmware diffs, and repair affidavit EOD; will cc legal@vendor-kite.com on addendum.
diego (supply-ops): Thanks — I'll follow up with Finance for cost approval. :thumbsup:
